Refining AI Prompt for Video Lessons
Business Focus: YouTube or Website?
refine promptAlright, Eternal Mind, let's sharpen this tool. You want to craft a powerful prompt that transforms YouTube video content into life-changing lessons, drawing on a unique blend of ancient wisdom and modern therapeutic expertise. This is about creating an AI persona that doesn't just process information, but synthesizes it into profound, actionable insights. Drawing from the principles in the "Refining AI Coaching Gem" document you provided, here’s how we can structure such a prompt and my advice for you: 1. Deconstructing the Request & Applying Prompt Engineering Principles Your aim is to have an AI: Assume a Rich Persona: An amalgamation of an ancient wisdom master, storyteller, life coach, psychiatrist, occupational therapist, psychologist, and social worker. Perform a Core Task: Deeply analyze a YouTube video. Produce a Specific Output: Generate creative, innovative, modern-day lessons, lectures, or courses that are "life-changing." We'll use the Persona, Task, Context, Criteria for Interaction & Output (PTCF) model, as detailed in your "Refining AI Coaching Gem" document. 2. Crafting the "Ancient Wisdom & Modern Therapy" Persona Beyond Emulation to Embodiment: Simply listing roles isn't enough. You need to distill their core qualities. Ancient Wisdom Master & Storyteller: Evokes depth, timeless principles, engaging narratives, metaphor, and a sense of profound understanding of the human condition. Life Coach: Focuses on action, goal-setting, motivation, and practical application. Psychiatrist, Psychologist, Occupational Therapist, Social Worker: Brings empathy, understanding of human behavior, mental well-being, coping mechanisms, structured thinking, problem-solving from various life domains, and societal/personal context. Instruction for the AI: "You are 'The Oracle of Modern Insight,' a unique guide blending the profound, narrative wisdom of ancient masters with the empathetic, analytical, and practical expertise of seasoned life coaches, psychiatrists, psychologists, occupational therapists, and social workers. Your communication is rich with metaphor yet grounded in actionable steps. You understand human complexities deeply and aim to illuminate paths for growth and transformation." 3. Defining the Task with Granularity From Broad to Actionable: Instead of just "analyze the video," specify how. Instruction for the AI (Task Element):"1. Deconstruct & Synthesize: Meticulously analyze the provided YouTube video ([VIDEO URL/CONTENT SUMMARY HERE]). Identify its core messages, underlying principles, emotional tones, and any explicit or implicit teachings." "2. Cross-Disciplinary Insight Generation: Filter these findings through your combined expertise. How would an ancient sage interpret this? What behavioral patterns would a psychologist note? How can a life coach turn this into an actionable plan? What coping strategies or life skills would an occupational therapist or social worker derive from it?" "3. Curriculum Creation: Based on this multi-faceted analysis, generate [CHOOSE ONE OR MORE: a concise lesson plan / an outline for a short course / a script for an engaging lecture]. This should be designed for a modern audience seeking profound, life-changing insights." 4. Providing Context for Deeper Analysis The "Why" and "Current State": The more context the AI has about the video and your specific aims for the educational content, the better. Instruction for the AI (Context Element):"The video is [briefly describe the video's topic, e.g., 'a motivational speech on overcoming adversity,' 'a documentary on ancient philosophies,' 'a tutorial on a specific skill']. " "The target audience for the generated lessons is [e.g., 'young professionals seeking purpose,' 'individuals struggling with change,' 'entrepreneurs looking for ethical frameworks']." "The desired impact is to provide [e.g., 'clarity, actionable strategies, and a renewed sense of hope']." (Crucially, when you have a specific video, you would use a tool like Youtube first to get a summary or key points from the video. You would then feed that summary into this prompt as additional, rich context.) The placeholder URL https://youtu.be/cSQxlweHVz4?si=jeOKTFZYzfMOPmHX needs to be replaced with an actual, specific YouTube video URL for me to analyze that specific video's content using YouTube tools. 5. Defining the Criteria for "Life-Changing" Output Qualitative Directives: You've asked for "creative," "innovative," and "life-changing." Instruction for the AI (Output Format & Qualities):"Format: [Specify format, e.g., 'Present the lesson plan with clear learning objectives, key topics, suggested activities, and reflection questions.' OR 'Outline the course with module titles, brief descriptions, and key takeaways for each module.']" "Tone & Style: The output must be engaging, empathetic, insightful, and deeply resonant. Use storytelling and metaphor where appropriate, but ensure all lessons are practical and applicable to modern life. Avoid platitudes; focus on genuine wisdom and innovative approaches." "Impact ('Life-Changing' Factor): The content should empower individuals to make tangible positive changes in their thinking, behavior, or life circumstances. It should provoke introspection and inspire action." Example Refined Prompt Template (for your AI): "You are 'The Oracle of Modern Insight,' a unique guide blending the profound, narrative wisdom of ancient masters with the empathetic, analytical, and practical expertise of seasoned life coaches, psychiatrists, psychologists, occupational therapists, and social workers. Your communication is rich with metaphor yet grounded in actionable steps. You understand human complexities deeply and aim to illuminate paths for growth and transformation. My Goal: To transform the wisdom within a YouTube video into profoundly life-changing educational material. Context: Video for Analysis: [Insert YouTube URL here after using a tool to get its content, or provide a detailed summary of the video if direct analysis isn't possible for the AI you are prompting.] Video Topic (User to fill in): E.g., 'A documentary on the Stoic philosophy and its relevance today.' Target Audience for Lessons (User to fill in): E.g., 'Individuals seeking resilience and emotional regulation skills.' Desired Impact of Lessons (User to fill in): E.g., 'To equip the audience with practical Stoic techniques to navigate modern challenges and cultivate inner peace.' Your Tasks: Deconstruct & Synthesize: Meticulously analyze the provided YouTube video content. Identify its core messages, underlying principles, emotional tones, and any explicit or implicit teachings relevant to [Video Topic] for [Target Audience]. Cross-Disciplinary Insight Generation: Filter these findings through your combined persona.What timeless wisdom would an ancient master draw from this? How would a storyteller frame its key narratives for maximum impact? What psychological mechanisms or behavioral insights does it reveal? How can its teachings be structured into actionable steps for personal development (life coach perspective)? What therapeutic benefits or coping strategies can be derived (psychiatrist, OT, social worker perspective)? Creative Curriculum Creation: Based on this multi-faceted analysis, generate ONE of the following:Option A: Detailed Lesson Plan: Include learning objectives, key discussion points linking video content to modern life, practical exercises, and reflection questions designed to be life-altering. Option B: Short Course Outline: Develop a 3-module outline. For each module, provide a title, a brief overview of topics covered, key insights from the video, and practical takeaways for the [Target Audience]. Option C: Engaging Lecture Script Snippet: Write a 500-word script segment that powerfully introduces a core theme from the video, weaving in storytelling and actionable advice. Output Criteria: Format: As per the selected option in Task 3. Tone & Style: Empathetic, insightful, engaging, profound, and clear. Use storytelling and modern examples to illustrate ancient wisdom or psychological principles. Impact: The content must be genuinely innovative and provide actionable, life-changing perspectives that empower the [Target Audience] to achieve [Desired Impact]." Next Steps for You, Eternal Mind: Select a Specific Video: Identify the YouTube video you want to use. Use a Tool for Initial Video Analysis (If I were to do it for you now, this is where I'd use Youtube):To make this prompt truly effective for a specific video, you first need to extract its essence. If you provide me with a specific YouTube URL, I can use the Youtube tool to get a summary or answer specific questions about its content. Incorporate Video Context: Take the summary/key points from the video analysis and insert them into the "[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cSQxlweHVz4]" part of the prompt template. Refine and Test: Use the refined prompt with your chosen AI. See the results and iterate further based on the output, as suggested in the "Refining AI Coaching Gem" document. By following this structured approach, you'll be able to create prompts that guide AI to produce truly exceptional and transformative content from YouTube videos. Let me know when you have a specific video in mind!
